disposition_reason: EFSA NDA novel food opinion reporting applicant batch analyses of arsenic, mercury, lead and cadmium in five batches each of frozen, dried and powdered house cricket.

study.design: Regulatory novel food assessment; applicant batch-to-batch compositional data (five independently produced batches per form)
study.origin: farmed house crickets reared under HACCP on plant-based and fishmeal feed; applicant is a Belgian insect industry federation; farm location not stated
study.lod_text: not stated; non-detects printed as < 0.02 (As) and < 0.01 (Hg, Pb) mg/kg
study.qa: Accredited laboratory certificates provided; no CRM or recovery reported in the opinion

unresolved: Frozen batch #9 cadmium printed "0012" (no decimal point); not stored.
Frozen batch #9 arsenic 0.03 mg/kg equals the proposed frozen specification limit of < 30 µg/kg (30 µg/kg); noted.
Dried batch #51 cadmium 0.091 mg/kg is much higher than the other dried batches; printed as such.
